subject: POC trial planning & model selection - next steps

Subject: POC trial planning & model selection - next steps

Hi Olivia / Daniel —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

Summary of needs we captured:
- Use case: customer support triage + canned response suggestion across US/CA/FR/ES.
- Expected traffic for the trial: ~2k queries/day, peak 8k.
- Success criteria: 1) >= 85% accept rate on suggested responses (measured on a 1000-sample eval), 2) <= 350ms P95 latency, 3) cost target <$0.006/query.

Proposed POC plan (timeline):
- Week 0 (this week): sign SOW / mutual action plan and share POC requirements workbook (attached).
- Week 1: Redwood SE (Aditya) to spin up trial endpoint(s), provide model suggestions and fallback config.
- Week 2: Ingest sample SR logs, run evaluation/benchmarks, tune prompt + caching.
- Week 3: Joint evaluation against success criteria and handoff to CS for pilot.

Model selection notes (initial recommendation):
- Primary: Llama-3 13B (quantized fp4/amx) — good balance of quality/latency for multi-lingual support.
- Fallback: Mix of Llama-2 70B (for high-quality escapes) and a smaller 7B for cost-sensitive low-latency paths.
- Multilingual: We will use locale-aware prompt templates and a lightweight language detector to route to the same model; Aditya will validate FR/ES perf in Week 1.

Action items:
- Olivia/Daniel: confirm the success criteria and timeline above or propose edits (by EOD Friday).
- Aditya: prepare trial endpoint config + fallback policy and share estimated token costs.
- Marissa: raise SOW for signatures and coordinate dates.

Attachments: RDW_POC_requirements.xlsx (filled with SSO/account details, sample data format, success-metric templates).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: POC trial planning & model selection - next steps

Hi Olivia / Daniel —

Thanks — quick technical note based on your ask about prioritizing English: that's totally reasonable and what I'd recommend for the POC to keep cost and infra bounded. Proposed approach:

1) Primary route (EN): Llama-3 13B quantized (fp4) on our latency-optimized instance class. Should meet P95 targets for ~2k qps/day.
2) Fallback policy: if the prompt triggers one of the "high-quality" buckets (long context, complex instruction, low confidence score), route to Llama-2 70B (higher quality but higher cost) — we can set threshold conservatively during POC.
3) FR/ES handling: run a parallel small-scale test against your sample FR/ES logs using the same prompts but restricted traffic slices (we'll run evaluation jobs and return per-language accept rates). No separate endpoint required; we'll do model evaluation in Week 1 and, if needed, spin up a region-specific instance in Week 2.
4) Caching & batching: we'll enable prefix KV caching for repeated threads and set batching windows to balance throughput/latency. I estimate token cost per query (EN baseline) at ~$0.0045 with Llama-3 13B quantized; fallback to Llama-2 70B drives marginal cost to ~$0.012 for those queries.

Next steps for us:
- I'll push a draft endpoint config and a fallback-policy JSON to the shared Drive by EOD today (linked in HubSpot record).
- Neha (CS) will coordinate access for your SREs and confirm SSO details in the workbook.

If that approach sounds good we'll proceed Monday morning.

--
